title_en: Dark Lord of the Sith: Marvel's Latest Rogue One Prequel Showcases Darth Vader at His Most Terrifying and Deadly
summary_en: We've got an exclusive preview of Star Wars: Rogue One - Darth Vader #1, as Marvel showcases the Dark Lord of the Sith at his most imposing.
body_en:
2026 marks the tenth anniversary of Rogue One: A Star Wars Story. For the past several months, Marvel Comics has been celebrating that milestone by publishing a series of one-shot specials spotlighting the main players of the beloved Star Wars movie. Fittingly, that lineup comes to an end with a final one-shot starring none other than Darth Vader himself, as the Dark Lord of the Sith once again proves himself to be a one-man army.
IGN can exclusively debut a new preview of Star Wars: Rogue One - Darth Vader #1. Check it out in the slideshow gallery below:
Star Wars: Rogue One - Darth Vader #1 is written by Chris Condon (Ultimate Wolverine) and drawn by Luke Ross (Star Wars: Legacy of Vader). This issue features cover art by David Marquez, Phil Noto, and Walt Simonson. Here's Marvel's official description of the book:
Star Wars: Rogue One - Darth Vader #1 will be released on October 28, 2026. You can preorder a copy at your local comic shop . You can also preorder the Star Wars: Rogue One trade paperback collection on Amazon.
For more, find out about the Your Friendly Neighborhood Spider-Man prequel comic and learn which major comics icon finally joined the Marvel Universe in Avengers: Armageddon #4.
Jesse is a mild-mannered staff writer for IGN. Allow him to lend a machete to your intellectual thicket by following @jschedeen on BlueSky .
